subject: Vista Healthcare - signature handshake and audit pack
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@vistahealthcare.com>, michael.tanaka@vistahealthcare.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vista Healthcare - signature handshake and audit pack

Elena / Michael —

Thanks again for moving quickly on the redlines. Attached is Vista_MSA_Redlines_v3.docx with the items we discussed highlighted (open items: Section 7.4 data retention, Section 12.2 indemnity scope). I’ve also attached a clean OrderForm_CleanCopy.pdf for the line items we agreed during commercial review.

To get to signature, proposed DocuSign routing (can change if you prefer):
  1) Procurement (Michael Tanaka) — acknowledgement of order form
  2) Vista Legal (Elena Rossi) — legal attestation / countersign if required
  3) Redwood Legal (Rishi Malhotra) — final countersign and execution

Ask: can you confirm the authorized signer for procurement and the email address you want us to use in the envelope? Also please confirm whether Vista requires a witness or corporate seal step — we’ll accommodate.

We’ll include the following in the Docusign envelope: redlines PDF, clean MSA, Order Form clean copy, and a short audit pack (SOC2 excerpt + contact for compliance requests). Once signed we’ll upload final clean copies to the shared Drive link below and send the certified PDF.

Target timeline: send envelope today, signatures completed by Friday 23 Apr if possible. If you need a different order or want Legal to sign before Procurement, tell me and we’ll adjust.

Attachments: Vista_MSA_Redlines_v3.docx, OrderForm_CleanCopy.pdf

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0197

---

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@vistahealthcare.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Tanaka <michael.tanaka@vistahealthcare.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 12:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vista Healthcare - signature handshake and audit pack

Thanks Naomi — we reviewed the redlines internally. A few quick points: 

- Procurement prefers to acknowledge and sign the Order Form before Legal performs the final review sign-off (procurement needs the PO on file). So please swap the envelope order so Michael signs first, then Legal.
- I am fine to sign for Vista Legal after Procurement, but confirm the person in Legal who will countersign (we need their full name and title for our records).
- Please attach a PDF of the redlines (not just the Word doc) and include the SOC2 excerpt you referenced.

For authority: Michael is our authorized procurement signer for contracts <$5M. Michael’s email is michael.tanaka@vistahealthcare.com (cc’d). We will include Sarah Nguyen (procurement team) as an observer/witness on the envelope.

If you can send the envelope today with updated attachments we’ll aim to route internally the same day.

Best,
Elena Rossi
SVP Legal, Vista Healthcare
elena.rossi@vistahealthcare.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@vistahealthcare.com>
Cc: Michael Tanaka <michael.tanaka@vistahealthcare.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vista Healthcare - signature handshake and audit pack

Perfect — thanks Elena. I’ve updated routing as requested (Procurement -> Vista Legal -> Redwood). Attached: OrderForm_CleanCopy.pdf, Vista_MSA_Redlines_v3.pdf (exported), and SOC2_Type2_Excerpt.pdf.

Quick confirmations needed: 
- Michael, please confirm you are the procurement signer and that michael.tanaka@vistahealthcare.com is the correct address for the envelope. 
- Elena, please confirm the name and title of the Vista Legal signee you want included (we’ll put the field in the envelope but won’t require signature until Procurement completes).
- Is Sarah Nguyen an actual signer/witness or would you prefer her to be a CC/recipient of the completed envelope? We can set her as a certified copy recipient if you like.

I will prepare the Docusign envelope from rishi.malhotra@redwood.com and set the signing deadline for 72 hours after initial send (we can extend if needed).

Docusign envelope (placeholder): https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123-ENVELOPE
Shared Drive (final copies): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/VISTA/VISTA-MSA-final

Thanks — I’ll wait for Michael/Elena confirmation and then send.

—
Naomi

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@vistahealthcare.com>, Michael Tanaka <michael.tanaka@vistahealthcare.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vista Healthcare - signature handshake and audit pack

Naomi — go ahead and send from my account once we have confirmations. A few internal notes:

- Envelope sender: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
- Execution order confirmed: Michael -> Elena -> Rishi (Redwood)
- Please enable the DocuSign certificate/audit trail export and include it in the post-signature audit pack. We retain contract artifacts in the contracts bucket for 7 years; ensure the drive copy and HubSpot record are updated automatically.
- If Vista wants a side letter for the Section 7.4 data-retention exception, we can include that as a separate attachment to be countersigned in the same envelope (preferred).

Once signed, I’ll countersign immediately and upload the certified PDF to the Drive link Naomi listed, and notify Finance to close the order.

Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Counsel | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Naomi / Elena —

Confirmed: I am the authorized procurement signer for this agreement and michael.tanaka@vistahealthcare.com is the correct signing email. I will review the envelope when received and aim to sign by COB Thu 22 Apr; target complete by Fri 23 Apr.

Sarah is being cc’d as witness/observer; please add her as a certified copy recipient so she receives the final executed PDF.

One small ask: on the retention clause (Section 7.4), Vista would like to capture the agreed exception in a one-page side letter (short, not reworking the MSA). If Redwood can prepare that and include it in the envelope we will countersign simultaneously.

Thanks — I’ll watch for the envelope.

Michael Tanaka
